explanation.walkthrough: 'Northern European' looks like a single definition, but northern is only the N; the definition is European alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A Catalan is a native of Catalonia in north-east Spain, so a person from Europe.

clue.text: Editor leaving very happy sound on tracks

explanation.definitionFit: Chuff is the puffing noise a steam locomotive makes as it runs along the railway line.

clue.text: Generosity of SSE?
